items.title: Terri Lyne Carrington interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: I mean when you look at like a Martin Luther King for instance, you know and a lot of political activists were ministers or pastors or have strong spiritual beliefs as well.

ctx.x: What was it called, I’m sorry?

Well Santeria and Yoruba, and they’re both pretty much the same thing. There’s slight differences. That’s why I say both names. There are slight differences and I’m not sure exactly what the differences are other than Yoruba is more like people from different parts of Africa, really practice Yoruba. And Santeria has a little bit more I think of a Christian or, I’m not sure if it’s Catholic, maybe even Catholic flavor. Somehow they made some slight changes from Yoruba to be able to practice it in a more Western…
Was your family active in the church?
